cockpit.title: Content Cockpit
cockpit.desc: Pick topics and scripts from your daily source board, then jump straight to recording.

analyze.title: Reference Analysis
analyze.desc: Drop in a video or link to get a breakdown report and a reproduction SOP.

produce.title: Produce
produce.desc: Hand a recording or script to the video engine and watch real progress through to a finished cut.

library.title: Library
library.desc: Your recordings, finished cuts, analysis reports and publish packages in one place.

engine.notReadyHint: Set INKAST_PIPELINE_ROOT or fix the video-pipeline path, then run the self-check.

produce.noKey: Producing slides needs a Claude or DeepSeek key. Configure it to produce for real.
produce.smokeBlocked: Engine self-check failed — fix the dependencies shown above (.venv/deps/ffmpeg) before submitting.

submit.title: Script → Video
submit.hint: Paste a script/idea — AI splits it into multi-page slides (review/edit at the checkpoint) then renders the video. Edit screen recordings in the Record tab.
submit.placeholder_slides: Paste a script / idea / source material to narrate as slides…
submit.errorNoKey: Slide splitting needs an LLM key (Claude / Kimi / DeepSeek, etc.). Configure a key before producing.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.empty: No jobs yet. Submit something on the left.

preview.optionHint: After confirming the script, render a cover + 3s motion preview first; review before committing to the full render.
preview.title: Pre-render preview
preview.hint: A lightweight preview is ready (not the final film). Happy? Click "Confirm & render". Want changes? "Back to edit".
preview.none: No preview artifacts found (re-run or go back to edit).

search.title: Search everything
search.placeholder: Search topics / takes / analyses / recordings / films / drafts… (⌘K)
search.hint: Type to search across everything. Topics/takes jump to the cockpit; files open in Finder.

cockpit.dirHint: Click "Choose folder" below to point at your KnowledgePlanet 每日驾驶舱 folder (or set INKAST_COCKPIT_DIR).
cockpit.myOpinionPlaceholder: Write your take/angle on this topic — it flows into the script when you go to Record or Produce.
cockpit.resizeDetail: Drag to resize the detail panel
cockpit.genArticleHint: Draft a WeChat article from the topic + your take; one-click to the publish board

article.title: Article draft
article.hint: Rewrites from the topic + your take; edit, then save or send to the board
article.placeholder: Click "Draft article" to start with AI, or write here directly.
article.sent: Sent to publish board (Drafts); topic marked "pushed draft"
article.sendFailed: Failed to send to the board

cockpit.title: Content cockpit
cockpit.detailEmpty: Select an item to see details
cockpit.goRecordHint: Load this topic's script into the teleprompter and switch to recording
cockpit.goProduceHint: Send this topic to Produce as an idea (review before submitting; marks it Drafted when done)

todo.title: Project to-dos
todo.placeholder: Add a next step (Enter to add)

project.empty: No active projects yet. Change a status, add a take or a to-do under "Today's topics" and it shows up here to track.

opinions.title: My takes
opinions.empty: No takes yet. Write your take under a topic's "My take" and they gather here to search and reuse.

follow.placeholder: Paste a video link, or a YouTube/Douyin creator page
follow.hint: YouTube channels auto-list recent videos. Douyin creator pages track work-count changes and auto-add video cards when public posts are available.
follow.empty: Nothing saved yet. Paste a video link or creator page.

creatorPool.title: AI Creator Seed Pool
creatorPool.subtitle: Built-in recommended tracking pool · AI tools/tutorials/products/workflows only; drama·emotional·gaming hidden
creatorPool.manualReview: Needs manual review of recent content
creatorPool.candidateHint: These candidates lack a stable public Douyin ID and are not auto-imported; open search to verify manually before tracking.

comments.onlyDouyin: Comment fetching currently supports single Douyin videos only.
comments.manualHint: Inkast never fakes a successful fetch; open the video page manually, or let Computer Use assist with scrolling.

keys.title: LLM keys
keys.desc: Claude / Kimi for analysis vision (no Claude? use Kimi); DeepSeek for produce copy. Stored encrypted on this Mac — never plaintext, never in git, persists across restarts.
keys.replacePlaceholder: Configured · enter a new value to replace
keys.noEncryption: System keychain unavailable; can't store securely yet (macOS Keychain must be ready).
keys.note: Keys are encrypted via Electron safeStorage into userData/keys.json (decryptable only on this machine). Saving takes effect immediately for Produce/Analyze.

settings.title: External paths
settings.desc: Set the produce engine / publishing folder / cockpit folder here — no need to hand-edit config files. After moving folders or switching machines, just re-pick them here.
settings.envOverride: Overridden by env var; changes here won't apply
settings.adoptHint: Adopt = freeze-copy the current engine into an app-owned location; after that, editing/moving/deleting your dev folder won't break Produce. To update the engine, pick a new folder first, then adopt again.
settings.note: Defaults point at this machine's knowledge base. Picking a folder writes a userData config and applies immediately (no restart needed for the engine).

backup.title: Export backup
backup.desc: Export the app's topic statuses / project to-dos / takes / article drafts / produce job history / follows / config to a folder you pick. Excludes media files (recordings, films, analysis reports) and keys.

publish.title: Publish board
publish.dirHint: Click "Choose folder" below to point at your Operations/Publishing folder (or set INKAST_PUBLISHING_DIR).
publish.previewBinary: Not a text file; can't preview. Use the Finder button top-right.

actions.moveHint: Move all files of this draft to:
actions.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft and its {{n}} file(s)?

flow.done: Project created in 110 video workspace with material copied; the Codex startup prompt is on your clipboard.

analyze.title: Reference analysis
analyze.urlPlaceholder: Paste a Douyin / YouTube video link
analyze.urlHint: Douyin: paste a public video/share link (no yt-dlp; reads the public share page's watermarked play URL). YouTube etc.: install the yt-dlp component below.
analyze.ytdlpInstallFailed: Component install failed; try brew install yt-dlp in a terminal.
analyze.ytdlpMissing: yt-dlp component not installed — click Install or brew install yt-dlp.
analyze.personaPlaceholder: My niche / account persona (optional, e.g. career tips · anti-cliché · calm deconstruction)
analyze.personaHint: Filled in → the remix kit (hooks/titles/scripts/prompts) is tailored to your account's positioning and tone; left blank → generic rewrite.
analyze.keyHint: Analysis needs a vision model to "see" frames. Click to configure Claude or Kimi — no Claude? use Kimi (DeepSeek is text-only, can't analyze).
analyze.ffmpegHint: ffmpeg not found (needed for frame extraction). Install via brew install ffmpeg, then refresh.
analyze.placeholder: Choose a video and click Analyze to get a teardown report + reproduction SOP.
analyze.reportReadFailed: Couldn't read this report (report.md may be deleted/moved/corrupted). Refresh or re-run analysis.
analyze.transcribeToggle: Transcribe audio for a transcript (more accurate; first run downloads the whisper model; turn off if no audio)
analyze.transcribeDownloading: Downloading transcription model (first run, tens of MB)…
analyze.transcribeFailed: Audio transcription failed (no audio / decode error); analyzing frames only.

newRecording.title: Return to Recorder
newRecording.description: Your current session has been saved.

errors.unableToDetermineSourcePath: Unable to determine source video path
errors.exportBackgroundLoadFailed: Export failed: could not load background image ({{url}})

media.dragHint: Drop an image or video onto the preview to add it as a picture-in-picture overlay.

recording.saveFailedFileKept: Failed to save the recording. The raw video file has been kept in the recordings folder so you can recover it.
recording.cameraBlocked: Camera access is blocked. Enable it in system settings to use the webcam.
recording.systemAudioUnavailable: System audio not available. Recording without system audio.
recording.microphoneDenied: Microphone access denied. Recording will continue without audio.
recording.cameraDenied: Camera access denied. Recording will continue without webcam.
recording.permissionDenied: Recording permission denied. Please allow screen recording.
recording.accessibilityAllowAndRetry: Allow Accessibility access for OpenScreen, then press record again to start the countdown.

emptyState.title: No project open
emptyState.description: Record a new video, or import an existing one to start editing.
emptyState.supportedFormats: Supported formats: MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI, M4V, WMV
emptyState.dragDropHint: or drag & drop a .openscreen project file here

dropErrors.unsupportedFormatMessage: Only .openscreen project files can be dropped here. To import a video file, use the "Import Video File…" button on this screen.
dropErrors.couldNotOpenMessage: The project file could not be opened. The video it references may have been moved or deleted.

overlay.imageFormatsOnly: Please upload a JPG, PNG, GIF, or WebP image.
overlay.dropHint: Drop to insert an image/video as a picture-in-picture overlay

avatar.apiKeyKeep: API Key (set; leave blank to keep)
avatar.genericJsonInvalid: Generic adapter mapping JSON is invalid — please check.
avatar.setupHint: First register your avatar in the providers console (consent/likeness) and get an API key; HeyGen can build an avatar from a single photo. Inkast only sends the script and fetches the MP4.
avatar.scriptPlaceholder: Paste the voiceover script (≥10 chars; can reuse analysis output ③)
avatar.needConfig: Fill API key + avatar/voice in Avatar settings above first.
avatar.jobsEmpty: No avatar jobs yet. Paste a script on the left.
